I've updated the project memory to say releases now go through `make release`, which tags and publishes, so no manual tagging or publishing.

- **Old entry:** the previous memory said to release by pushing a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag and letting CI publish. I marked it as outdated rather than deleting it, so it stays in the history. It was a shared entry written by a person, so anyone else using it will now see the new process instead.
- **No Makefile here:** this repo has no Makefile and no `release` target yet, so `make release` won't work from this checkout. Maybe the target lives somewhere else or hasn't been merged in. Let me know if I should add it.
- **Tag format:** I don't know if `make release` still uses `vYYYY.MM.N` tags, and I noted that as unconfirmed in the memory. Tell me if it's changed and I'll update it.
